rationale: C01 is a concrete drafting template for the child: both recite the same section 350(a) authority, identify an earlier bilateral trade agreement and the proclamation carrying it out, state an intergovernmental agreement ending that arrangement, recite the statutory power to terminate the implementing proclamation, and conclude by terminating it at the close of a specified date. The language and sequence are substantially parallel, with Colombia, its dates, and its simpler termination condition replaced by Haiti and GATT/Annecy predicates. C17 is also closely related and supplies the GATT-accession transition machinery, but its operative result leaves the earlier proclamation partially effective rather than terminating it outright. C06 provides the immediate Haitian accession facts referenced by the child, but is principally a factual and legal predicate rather than the strongest termination-proclamation template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: under the authority vested in him by section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended by the act of June 12, 1934 ... entered into a trade agreement with the President of the Republic of Haiti ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: under the authority vested in him by section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended by the act of June 12, 1934 ... entered into a trade agreement with the President of the Republic of Colombia ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamation
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, closely matching opening recital with country and dates substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, authorizes the President to terminate any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section
shared_material.explanation: The same specific statutory termination authority is recited in nearly identical language and at the same point in the sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do proclaim that the said proclamation dated May 4, 1935, is hereby terminated as of the close of December 31, 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the said proclamation dated April 20, 1936, shall terminate and cease to have effect at the close of November 30, 1949
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical operative mechanism terminating a named trade-agreement proclamation at the close of a specified date.
